headline: Ducon Infratechnologies receives in-principle SEBI approval for rights issue of fully paid-up equity shares
sum: Ducon Infratechnologies Limited has received in-principle approval from SEBI to launch a rights issue of fully paid-up equity shares. The company disclosed this via NSE intimation under LODR Regulation 30.
detail: The company informed the NSE of receipt of in-principle SEBI approval for a fully paid-up equity rights offering, disclosed via formal exchange intimation. In-principle approval confirms that SEBI has cleared the broad terms of the offer at a preliminary stage. The full offer document and detailed terms (share ratio, pricing, record date, subscription period) remain to be disclosed in subsequent announcements. This is a standard capital-raising mechanism for listed companies under Indian securities law.
